data.description: Generates video from text using ByteDance Seedance via a real Comfy Cloud workflow run. Output is saved to the asset library with a reopenable graph. Pass `prompt` and optional `resolution` / `ratio` / `duration` / `seed`. For a cheaper, faster draft pass, set `model` to `Seedance 2.0 Mini` (~half the price of standard, ~2× faster than fast; 480p/720p only, 4–15s); `Seedance 2.0 Fast` (720p) and the default `Seedance 2.0` (up to 1080p) are the other tiers. For clips longer than 15s set `model` to `Seedance 2.5` (newest model, up to 30s, up to 1080p).
